lore.short: A necromancer in Necrokeep who's determined to find a cure for the Mist.

skills.name: Vicious Retrieval
skills.description:
When Faramis's skills deal damage to enemy heroes and summoned units, they leave behind Soul Fragments. Absorbing a Soul Fragment recovers 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) HP and grants 2  (up to 40 stacks).
Upon death, he consumes the absorbed Soul Fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%).
He can gain up to 1 Soul Fragment from the same enemy hero using skills every 4s. Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance to drop Soul Fragments.

skills.name: Shadow Stampede
skills.description:
Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3s, gaining 70% Movement Speed, 25 , and 20% Cooldown Reduction of this skill. He also gains the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes he touches take 250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are marked with a Nether Mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis pulls all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Use Again: Ends the Shadow state early to pull marked enemy heroes toward him.
Soul Fragment absorption range is increased while this skill is active.

skills.name: Ghost Bursters
skills.description: Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330 (+144% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200 (+86% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (splits up to 2 time(s) on enemy hero hits and 1 time(s) on non-enemy hero hits).

skills.name: Nether Realm
skills.description: Faramis turns his surroundings into the Nether Realm for 6s. Allied heroes within (including himself) enter the Specter state, gaining 400 (+ 10 (+5% Total Magic Power)%) extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When the Specter state breaks, heroes within clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1.3s. The Specter state immediately ends if the allied hero leaves the Nether Realm.

assist.desc: Faramis works well with heroes that are designed to dive into the enemy, such as Leomord and Martis, as he'll be able to maximize the life-saving effect of his Ultimate.

strong.desc: Faramis' ability to temporarily prevent teammates from being killed makes him a good pick against heroes that go all-in to burst down a target, like Saber and Eudora.

weak.desc: Faramis is countered by high mobility heroes that are difficult for him to catch with his 1st Skill, such as Novaria and Pharsa.
